'''Mick''' (Japanese: '''ニック''' ''Nick'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW065|Battling the Bully!]]''. 

Mick was a shy boy who didn't have too much confidence. One day, he encountered {{AP|Pikachu}} that came falling from the sky and into his arms. It electrocuted him out of fright, and he assumed that, because it can use {{t|Electric}} attacks, it was the pre-evolved form of a {{p|Zekrom}}. He proceeded to show it off to his friends [[Glenn]] and [[Sean]]. However, Sean identified it as a Pikachu, and Mick left.

He bonded with Pikachu and later met {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}}. Ash taught Mick how to battle, letting him use Pikachu while Ash used [[Sunglasses Krokorok|Krokorok]], and later {{AP|Tepig}}. Mick was thrilled to have learned how to battle, and then returned to battle Glenn and Sean. The three of them had a [[Double Battle]], with Sean and Glenn using a {{p|Scolipede}} and {{p|Seismitoad}} belonging to Sean's father, and Mick using Pikachu and Krokorok. Mick ended up winning the match due to Sean and Glenn constantly arguing with each other. He and his friends watched as Ash {{pkmn2|caught}} Krokorok.

==Trivia==
*In the {{pmin|Latin America|Latin American dub}}, he shares his voice actress with {{wp|List of Doraemon characters|Nobita}}, from the {{wp|Doraemon}} anime. This was likely done due to Mick's similarities with that character.
*In the {{pmin|Finland|Finnish dub}}, Mick has the same voice actress as {{Ash}} had during the first 3 seasons and first 4 movies of the series, Sari Ann Moilanen. Ironically enough, Mick also borrows Ash's Pikachu.
